image_richardson_tortoise.jpg.ImageDescription: Tenniel's drawing of Alice with the Mock Turtle and the Gryphon, shown on the Beautiful Soup page under the line 'We called him Tortoise because he taught us'
image_richardson_tortoise.jpg.licence_note: The drawing is by John Tenniel (1820-1914) for Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1865) and is in the public domain by its age. The file is the copy served by crummy.com; that site carries a general 'All rights reserved' line and no statement about this file, so the scan itself has no recorded licence.
